link.note: REMOVED: Geni lists him among John Petriello's children, but FS tree L6MH-TCL shows he was son of Michelarcangelo Petriello and Benedetta Ladye, another Guardia family. Not John's relative as listed; do not treat as a child of John Petriello.

summary: Mis-attached 'son' of John Petriello on Geni; belongs to another Guardia Petriello family.
bio: Geni: Rocco James b. 8 Sep 1889, Italy (Round 2 FS: 19 Sep 1889). Immigrated 1909; lived in Farrell and Berwick, PA and in Ohio; died 1980. His removal voids Round 1's 'first arrival 1889-95' inference for John Petriello.
